front.title: Test Vectors for the WIMSE HTTP Message Signatures Protocol

abstract.t: This document provides a set of test vectors for the WIMSE Workload- to-Workload Authentication protocol based on HTTP Message Signatures, as specified in draft-ietf-wimse-http-signature. The collection comprises six positive test cases, twenty-three negative test cases each mapped to a specific normative requirement of that specification, and three documented observations. All key material is test-only and fully published in this document, so that every vector can be recomputed independently. This document defines no new protocol behavior.
